description: This file manages unlockable items (weapons, upgrades, buildables, classes) in the game, including their states, thresholds, and network synchronization. It includes functions for initializing, importing, updating, and querying unlockable data, with conditional compilation for server, client, and game-specific code.

methods.name: BG_InitUnlockackables
methods.description: Initializes unlockable data structures and offsets.

methods.name: BG_ImportUnlockablesFromMask
methods.description: Imports unlockable states from a bitmask for a specific team.

methods.name: BG_UnlockablesMask
methods.description: Returns the unlockables bitmask for a team.

methods.name: BG_UnlockableType
methods.description: Returns the type of an unlockable item.

methods.name: BG_UnlockableTypeIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of an unlockable item.

methods.name: BG_WeaponUnlocked
methods.description: Checks if a weapon is unlocked.

methods.name: BG_UpgradeUnlocked
methods.description: Checks if an upgrade is unlocked.

methods.name: BG_BuildableUnlocked
methods.description: Checks if a buildable is unlocked.

methods.name: BG_ClassUnlocked
methods.description: Checks if a class is unlocked.

methods.name: BG_IterateMomentumThresholds
methods.description: Iterates over momentum thresholds for unlockables.
